angle: Episode 2 of the ServiceNow Telugu series: get your own free PDI, log in, and create a first incident (the VPN ticket from Ep 1), told to freshers, non-IT switchers and the MERN developer who commented on Ep 1.

hooks.text: Fresher aa? Non-IT nundi switch avthunnara? Leda MERN stack nundi ServiceNow ki move avvalani anukuntunnara? ServiceNow lo inka emi nerchukune mundhu, meeku oka free thing kaavali. Adhi enduku first?
hooks.english_rendering_scored: Fresher, non-IT, or switching from MERN? Before you learn anything else in ServiceNow, you need 1 free thing. But why first?

hooks.text: ServiceNow videos chusthunnaru, kani practice cheyyatledha? Alaa aithe months waste avvachu, bro. Inko video chuse mundhu, mee free PDI teesukondi.
hooks.english_rendering_scored: You're watching ServiceNow videos but never practicing, and that can waste months. Get your free PDI before you watch another one.

beats.say: Fresher aa? Non-IT nundi switch avthunnara? Leda MERN stack nundi ServiceNow ki move avvalani anukuntunnara? ServiceNow lo inka emi nerchukune mundhu, meeku oka free thing kaavali. Adhi enduku first?
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera, talking straight to the viewer
beats.record_note: Face cam, close framing, look straight into the lens. No logo, no intro music before this line.

beats.say: Ee video end ayye sariki meeku three things untayi. Mee own free ServiceNow instance, mee admin login, and mee first incident. Ivanni naa screen meeda live ga chesi chupisthanu.
beats.on_screen: Creator, then a 3-second flash of the finished incident record
beats.record_note: Face cam for the first sentence, then a 3-second cutaway to the finished incident record from clip 13 (instance URL blurred). Back to face cam for the last sentence.

beats.say: Last video end lo cheppanu kadha, next video lo PDI create cheddham ani. Aa video ki oka comment vachindhi, bro. Oka viewer ki MERN stack lo konni years experience undhi. Four months nundi interview calls raaledhu. Anduke ServiceNow developer role ki switch avvalani anukuntunnaru. Bro, meeru ye background nundi vachina, first step idhe. Nenu job guarantee cheppanu. Kani hands-on practice lekunda ServiceNow nerchukovadam chaala kastam. Okay bro, ippudu actual topic loki veldham.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera; the Ep 1 comment appears beside them, handle blurred
beats.record_note: Face cam. Editor overlays the Ep 1 comment screenshot (asset A2) while you read it, with the commenter's handle and avatar blurred.

beats.say: Ee video lo four steps. First, developer account create cheddham. Second, mee free PDI request cheddham. Third, first login chesi oka look around. Fourth, mee first incident. Last lo, mee PDI ni ela safe ga unchukovalo kuda cheptha. Okavela edaina step lo stuck ayithe, video pause chesi naa screen tho compare cheyyandi.
beats.on_screen: Creator; card with the four steps
beats.record_note: Face cam. Editor shows the four steps as a numbered list card.

beats.say: Mundhu oka real-time example. Meeru office lo ServiceNow developer anukondi. Company instance lo direct ga experiments cheyyaru kadha. Akkada real users, real tickets untayi. Oka chinna mistake chesina, andhariki problem. Anduke companies lo development kosam separate instance untundhi.
beats.on_screen: Creator explains; slide: company instance vs practice instance
beats.record_note: Face cam. Optional: simple slide with two boxes, 'Company instance: real users' vs 'Practice instance: only you'.

beats.say: PDI ante Personal Developer Instance. Simple ga cheppalante, ServiceNow meeku free ga ichhe mee own practice instance. Idhi mee personal sandbox. Ikkada meeru admin. Incidents create cheyyochu, forms change cheyyochu, scripts rayochu. Edaina break ayina parledhu. Okka rule maatram gurthupettukondi. Idhi learning kosam. Company data, real customer data ikkada eppudu pettakandi.
beats.on_screen: Creator; text card 'PDI = Personal Developer Instance'
beats.record_note: Face cam. Lower third or slide: 'PDI = Personal Developer Instance'.

beats.say: Inko point, bro. Interview lo meeru ServiceNow lo emi chesaru ani adigithe, videos chusanu ani cheppadam kanna, naa PDI lo incidents create chesanu, forms lo fields chusanu ani cheppadam chaala strong ga untundhi. Kani gurthupettukondi, PDI unte job vasthundhi ani kaadhu. Idhi practice cheyyadaniki oka place maatrame. Practice meeru cheyyali.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera
beats.record_note: Face cam.

beats.say: Meeku kaavalsindhi chaala simple. Oka laptop leda desktop lo browser, oka email ID, and konchem patience. Instance ready avvadaniki konchem time padutundhi. Ade step lo chupisthanu.
beats.on_screen: Creator; checklist card: browser, email, patience
beats.record_note: Face cam.

beats.say: Okay. Now, let's start. Step one. Browser open chesi developer dot servicenow dot com ki vellandi. Link description lo pedathanu. Idhi ServiceNow official developer site. Random sites lo, paid links lo veellakandi. Official site maatrame use cheyyandi.
beats.on_screen: Browser: typing developer.servicenow.com, the developer site home page
beats.record_note: Screen: clean browser profile, type developer.servicenow.com in the address bar slowly, land on the home page. Face cam picture-in-picture bottom right if you record it.

beats.say: Ikkada top lo sign in option untundhi. Meeku already ServiceNow account lekapothe, kotha account create cheyyali. Naa screen lo ee button chudandi. Idhi click chesthunna.
beats.on_screen: Cursor on the sign-in or sign-up button, click
beats.record_note: Screen: hover the sign-in or sign-up control, pause one second, click. READ THE LABEL AS IT APPEARS (verify item V2).

beats.say: Ippudu oka form vasthundhi. Name, email, password, ilaanti details adugutharu. Mee real name, mee regular email ivvandi. Temporary email vaddhu, endhukante mee instance ee account tho ne link ayyi untundhi. Password strong ga pettandi. Naa password screen lo kanipinchakunda blur chesthunna.
beats.on_screen: Sign-up form being filled; email and password blurred
beats.record_note: Screen: fill the form. BLUR the email field and the password field. Do not let the browser autofill dropdown show saved emails. Read the field names that actually appear (V3).

beats.say: Submit chesaka, mee email ki verification mail vasthundhi. Aa mail open chesi verify cheyyandi. Mail kanipinchakapothe spam folder kuda check cheyyandi, bro. Naa inbox ni nenu ikkada chupinchanu, privacy kosam.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera; optional 'check your email' page
beats.record_note: Face cam only. Optionally a few seconds of the 'check your email' confirmation page. NEVER record the inbox. If no verification mail is sent in your flow, drop this beat (V4).

beats.say: Verify ayyaka, malli developer site ki vachi, mee email and password tho sign in avvandi. First time login lo konni questions adagavachu, meeru student aa, developer aa, ilaanti. Mee situation ki taggattu select cheyyandi. Ikkada correct answer, wrong answer ani emi ledhu.
beats.on_screen: Developer site sign-in, then onboarding questions
beats.record_note: Screen: sign in (BLUR email, password). Show any onboarding questions as they appear and answer them (V5). If none appear, cut the second half of this line.

beats.say: Step two. Login ayyaka, instance request chese option untundhi. Naa screen lo adhi ikkada undhi, chudandi. Click cheyyandi.
beats.on_screen: Developer site dashboard, cursor on the request-instance button
beats.record_note: Screen: move the cursor to the request-instance button, pause, click. Read its label exactly (V6).

beats.say: Konni saarlu ServiceNow release select cheyyamani adugutharu. Naa screen lo ippudu ee options kanipisthunnayi. Beginner ga meeru, recommended ani unnadhi leda latest ani unnadhi teesukondi. Mee screen lo options naa screen kanna different ga undachu. Adhi normal, bro.
beats.on_screen: Release selection options, cursor on the recommended one
beats.record_note: Screen: if a release choice appears, hover each option and read the names as they appear (V7). If no choice appears, say 'naaku release choice raaledhu' instead.

beats.say: Request chesaka, instance ready avvadaniki konchem time padutundhi. Ee wait time andhariki same undakapovachu. Naa recording lo ee wait ni cut chesthunna. Meeru tension padakandi, ready ayye varaku wait cheyyandi.
beats.on_screen: Instance setup progress page, then a jump cut
beats.record_note: Screen: keep recording through the progress page; note the real wait time on paper for the editor (V8). Editor cuts the wait.

beats.say: Ready ayyaka, mee instance details kanipisthayi. Moodu important things. Instance URL, username, and password. Naa screen lo URL ila undhi, username ikkada undhi. Ee password ni ventane oka safe place lo save cheyyandi.
beats.on_screen: Instance details panel; URL and password blurred
beats.record_note: Screen: the instance details panel. BLUR the instance URL number and the password. Read the username exactly as shown (V9). Confirm the account is an admin (V24).

beats.say: Okka important point, bro. Ee URL, password evvariki share cheyyakandi. Screenshot teesi WhatsApp groups lo, comments lo pettakandi. Mee password evari daggara unna, mee instance lo login ayyi edaina cheyyochu. Anduke naa password ni blur chesthunna.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera; warning card
beats.record_note: Face cam, serious tone.

beats.say: Step three. Ippudu instance URL ni browser lo open cheyyandi. Login page vasthundhi. Username, password type cheyyandi. First login lo password change cheyyamani adagavachu. Adigithe kotha strong password pettandi, and adhi kuda save cheskondi.
beats.on_screen: Instance login page; URL bar and password blurred
beats.chapter: Step 3: First login, oka look around
beats.record_note: Screen: open the instance URL (BLUR the address bar), log in (BLUR password). If a password-change prompt appears, show it and BLUR both fields (V10).

beats.say: Okay bro, idhi mee own ServiceNow instance. Meeru ippudu admin. Mee company lo ServiceNow use chesthe, structure almost ilaane untundhi. Kani mee company screen konchem different ga undachu, endhukante prathi company tana own setup chesukuntundhi, and version batti look maaruthundhi.
beats.on_screen: The instance home page right after login
beats.record_note: Screen: the landing page after login, cursor still. Face cam PiP. BLUR the URL bar.

beats.say: First, All ani menu undhi, naa screen lo chudandi. Idhi click chesthe ServiceNow lo unna applications, modules anni list lo kanipisthayi. Paina filter box lo type chesthe vethukodam easy. Udaharanaki incident ani type cheyyandi. Incident ki sambandhinchina modules anni vachesthayi.
beats.on_screen: Main navigation menu open, 'incident' typed in the filter
beats.record_note: Screen: click the main navigation menu, then type 'incident' in its filter box. Read the menu name as it appears (V11).

beats.say: Pakkane Favorites, History laanti options untayi, naa screen lo ivi. Meeru tharachu vaade pages ni favorite cheskovachu. History lo meeru last open chesina records kanipisthayi. Real-time project lo idhi chaala time save chesthundhi.
beats.on_screen: Cursor on Favorites, then History
beats.record_note: Screen: hover Favorites, then History, only if they exist with those names in your UI (V12). Otherwise say the names you see.

beats.say: Top right lo mee profile icon undhi. Click chesthe mee name, konni settings kanipisthayi. Mee instance ye release lo undho kuda telusukovali. Naa instance ee release lo undhi, chudandi. Interview lo ye release meedha work chesaru ani adagavachu, so idhi gurthupettukondi.
beats.on_screen: Profile menu, then the place where the release name is shown
beats.record_note: Screen: open the profile menu (BLUR any email shown). Then show where you found the release name, on the instance or on the developer site instance panel, and read it aloud (V13, V14).

beats.say: Ippudu main part. Last video lo VPN example cheppanu, gurthundha? Employee ki VPN connect avvadam ledhu, ticket raise chesthadu. Adhe ippudu mana PDI lo chesthamu. Mee first incident.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera; 'VPN not connecting' card
beats.record_note: Face cam, energy up.

beats.say: Menu lo incident ani type cheyyandi. Incident kindha kotha incident create chese option untundhi, naa screen lo idhi. Click cheyyandi. Ippudu oka empty incident form open avthundhi. Paina incident number already vachesindhi, chudandi.
beats.on_screen: New incident form, number field highlighted
beats.record_note: Screen: filter 'incident', click the create-new module (read its label, V15). Zoom in on the auto-generated number and read its prefix aloud (V16).

beats.say: Caller field lo, evaru problem report chesthunnaro aa user ni select cheyyali. PDI lo konni demo users already untaru. Naa screen lo ee user ni select chesthunna.
beats.on_screen: Caller lookup with demo users
beats.record_note: Screen: click the Caller lookup, pick any demo user, read the name you picked (V17).

beats.say: Short description lo, VPN not connecting ani type cheyyandi. Idhi ticket ki title laantidhi. Support team list lo chusedhi idhe, so clear ga rayali. Description lo inka details rayochu. Work from home lo unnanu, morning nundi VPN connect avvadam ledhu, ani.
beats.on_screen: Short description and Description being typed
beats.record_note: Screen: type 'VPN not connecting' in Short description, then the longer text in Description.

beats.say: Category lo network laanti option unte select cheyyandi. Ippudu Impact and Urgency chudandi. Ivi rendu change chesi, Priority ni gamaninchandi. Naa screen lo Impact, Urgency maarchagane Priority ila maarindhi. Ee logic gurinchi next video lo detail ga matladukundham.
beats.on_screen: Category, Impact, Urgency dropdowns; Priority field zoomed
beats.record_note: Screen: open Category and read the options (V18). Change Impact, then Urgency; zoom on Priority and read what it changed to (V19). If Priority does not change on its own, say so honestly.

beats.say: Ippudu Submit click cheyyandi. Mee incident list lo kanipisthundhi. Idhe, bro. Mee first incident. Incident number, caller, short description, priority, state, anni ikkada kanipisthunnayi.
beats.on_screen: Incident list with the new VPN incident highlighted
beats.record_note: Screen: click the save button (read its label, V20). On the list, hover your new row and point at each column you name; drop any column that is not there.

beats.say: Ikkada oka basic concept gurthupettukondi. ServiceNow lo rendu main views untayi, list and form. List lo chaala records okesari kanipisthayi. Form lo okka record full details tho kanipisthundhi. State field kuda chudandi, naa incident ippudu ee state lo undhi. Ee states anni next video lo detail ga chuddam.
beats.on_screen: Incident list, then the same incident opened as a form; State field highlighted
beats.record_note: Screen: show the list, then click into the record to show the form. Point at the State field and read the value shown (V23).

beats.say: Record open chesi kindha chudandi. Activity section lo, evaru eppudu emi change chesaro history untundhi. Real-time project lo ticket meedha emi jarigindho telusukovadaniki idhi chaala important.
beats.on_screen: Incident record scrolled to its activity history
beats.record_note: Screen: open the incident, scroll to the activity / history area (read its real name, V21).

beats.say: Last, okka important tip. PDI free, kani chaala rojulu use cheyyakapothe instance sleep loki vellachu leda release avvachu. Exact rules developer site lo untayi. Naa screen lo ee message undhi, chudandi. Simple solution enti ante, regular ga login ayyi practice cheyyandi. Consistency tho nerchukundham.
beats.on_screen: Developer site text about inactivity, highlighted
beats.chapter: Mee PDI ni safe ga unchukovadam
beats.record_note: Screen: on the developer site, show the text that explains inactivity, sleep or reclaim, and READ IT OFF THE SCREEN (V22). Do not say any number of days that is not written there. Face cam PiP.

beats.say: Mee homework, bro. Ee video tarvatha mee PDI lo inko rendu incidents create cheyyandi. Okati printer not working, inkokati email not syncing. Different Impact, Urgency try chesi, Priority ela maaruthundho chudandi. Small small examples tho ne nerchukuntam.
beats.on_screen: Creator; homework card with the two ticket titles
beats.record_note: Face cam.

beats.say: Meeru important code leda configuration chesthe, adhi backup cheskovadam kuda nerchukovali. Adhi update sets topic lo, tharvatha videos lo chupisthanu.
beats.on_screen: Creator on camera
beats.record_note: Face cam.

beats.say: So, ee video lo meeru moodu things chesaru. Developer account create chesaru. Mee free PDI teesukunnaru. Login ayyi mee first incident create chesaru. Starting lo cheppina three things, ivi, bro.
beats.on_screen: Creator; three ticks: account, PDI, first incident
beats.record_note: Face cam. Editor can flash the three steps as ticks.

beats.say: Comments lo cheppandi: PDI create chesetappudu meeru ye step lo stuck ayyaru? Kani mee instance URL, password maatram comments lo pettakandi.
beats.on_screen: Creator pointing to comments
beats.record_note: Face cam, point down toward the comments.

beats.say: Next video lo, ee PDI lo Incident Management hands-on chesthamu. Incident ni create chesina daggara nundi resolve chese varaku, real-time scenario tho, step-by-step. Appati varaku mee PDI ready ga unchukondi. See you in the next video. Bye, bro.
beats.on_screen: Creator waves; end screen card for Ep 3
beats.record_note: Face cam, smile, wave on 'Bye, bro'. Hold 3 seconds of silence after for the end screen.

chapters.title: Step 3: First login, oka look around
Mee PDI ni safe ga unchukovadam

notes: Recorded video: 'record' (facecam|screen|both) and 'clip' (shot-list filename) are the source of truth for footage. Face-cam beats carry visual 'text' (or 'image' for the comment screenshot) only so no stock footage is ever fetched; broll_query is empty on purpose. UI labels in 'say' are phrased so the creator reads them off their own screen; see VERIFY WHILE RECORDING in shot-list.md.
